title: Welcome to Branded Galaxy
instruction: Welcome, Commander. Branded Galaxy is a turn-based grand strategy game of galactic conquest. Your mission: grow the influence of The Brand Authority across the stars.
hint: Let's begin with a quick tour of the basics.

title: The Galaxy Map
instruction: This is your galaxy. Pan around by clicking and dragging. Zoom in and out with the scroll wheel. Explore your starting systems and the surrounding space.
hint: Click and drag to pan the map.

title: Your Systems
instruction: The blue systems belong to The Brand Authority — that's you. Click on your Capital Prime system to open its System Detail panel.

title: Your Resources
instruction: At the top of the screen you'll see your resource bar: Credits ◆ (orange), Materials ⚙ (blue), Recruits ♟ (green), and Influence ★ (purple). These drive everything from fleet upkeep to facility construction.

title: Building a Facility
instruction: Facilities boost your systems. Click Capital Prime, then open the FACILITIES tab in the System Detail panel. Queue a Shipyard — it will complete over the next few turns.
hint: Click Capital Prime → FACILITIES tab → Queue a Shipyard.

title: End Your Turn
instruction: When you're ready, click the [END TURN] button on the left side of the top toolbar. The game will process the Resolution Phase and then the Maintenance Phase before your next turn.
hint: Click [END TURN] to advance to the next turn.

title: Turn Results
instruction: Excellent! The Turn Summary shows what happened: resources produced, construction progress, and any events. Review the summary, then dismiss it.

title: Your Fleet
instruction: Fleets are how you project power across the galaxy. Open the Fleet panel using the FLEET button on the right side of the screen.
hint: Click the Fleet nav button to open the Fleet panel.

title: Issue a Fleet Order
instruction: Select one of your fleets and issue a command order. Fleets can Patrol a system, Raid for resources, or Blockade enemy supply lines.
hint: Select a fleet, then assign a command order.

title: Your Characters
instruction: Characters are powerful individuals who can command fleets, lead missions, and boost your systems. Open the Character Roster.
hint: Click the CHARS nav button to open the roster.

title: Send a Mission
instruction: Assign a character to a Reconnaissance mission against a neutral system. Missions gather intelligence and can shift system loyalties.
hint: Open a character card and start a Reconnaissance mission.

title: Research Technology
instruction: The Tech Tree is always visible inside the Research panel. Click the Research nav button on the right side of the screen to open it, then click a technology node to queue it for research.
hint: Open the Research panel and click a technology node to start researching it.

title: Victory Conditions
instruction: Click the Victory nav button or press V to open the Victory screen. It shows your progress toward each win condition. The first faction to meet any win condition claims victory!
hint: Click the VICTORY nav button or press V to view your victory progress.

title: Tutorial Complete!
instruction: Excellent work, Commander. You now know the basics of Branded Galaxy. The galaxy awaits your conquest — good luck!
